```
add the charge endpoint
→ retry failed charges with backoff

→ return 409 on duplicate keys                  (3ccedb3fa524 — original commit, restored, not recreated)
→ raise the retry budget for charges            (rebased, kept)
→ note the 409 behaviour in the changelog       (your current working-copy commit, kept)
```

I used `jj operation revert` on the squash operation, which brought back `return 409 on duplicate keys` as the actual original commit (same change ID, not a new equivalent commit). Its first attempt rebased your two later commits onto the pre-squash parent instead of onto the restored commit, which would have silently dropped the 409 handling code from the branch tip — I caught that by diffing and fixed it with one `jj rebase` to put the restored commit back in the right place in the stack.
